question: In January 2025, who has been appointed as the CEO of the Delhi Waqf Board?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Azimul Haque**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Azimul Haque** has been appointed as the **CEO of the Delhi Waqf Board** in **January 2025**. This appointment is significant as the Delhi Waqf Board plays a crucial role in managing waqf properties and ensuring their proper utilization.
 
• The **Delhi Waqf Board** is a statutory body established under the **Waqf Act, 1995**, which governs waqf properties and related matters in India.
 
• **Azimul Haque** is known for his extensive administrative experience and in-depth understanding of waqf properties, making him an ideal choice for this role.
 
• The CEO of the Waqf Board is responsible for overseeing the management, preservation, and development of waqf properties and ensuring their compliance with legal and administrative frameworks.
 
• This appointment aligns with the government's commitment to strengthening the functioning of statutory bodies like the Waqf Board and ensuring transparency and accountability in their operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delhi Waqf Board:**

 
 
• The Delhi Waqf Board is responsible for managing waqf properties in the region, which include mosques, graveyards, dargahs, and other charitable institutions.
 
• It ensures that waqf properties are used for purposes aligned with Islamic principles, such as education, welfare, and religious activities.
 
• The Board also takes steps to prevent encroachments and misuse of waqf properties and ensures their proper maintenance and revenue generation.
 
 
 
• **Waqf Act, 1995:**
 
 
• The Waqf Act, 1995, is a central legislation enacted to provide for the administration and supervision of waqf properties in India.
 
• The Act defines waqf as a permanent dedication of movable or immovable property by a Muslim for religious, pious, or charitable purposes.
 
• It establishes Waqf Boards at the state level to manage and regulate waqf properties in their respective jurisdictions.
 
 
 
• **Role of the CEO:**
 
 
• The CEO of the Waqf Board is a key administrative position responsible for implementing policies, managing staff, and ensuring the proper functioning of the Board.
 
• The CEO also liaises with government agencies, legal authorities, and other stakeholders to address issues related to waqf properties.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Waqf Management:**
 
 
• Encroachments on waqf properties and illegal occupation are major challenges faced by Waqf Boards across India.
 
• Limited financial resources and lack of skilled personnel often hinder the effective management and development of waqf properties.
 
• Efforts are being made to digitize records and introduce modern management practices to address these challenges.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Encroachment Issues:** Waqf Boards in India have been facing challenges due to widespread encroachments on waqf properties. Ensuring proper legal action and recovery of these properties is a major priority for the Board.
 
• **Digitization:** The Government of India has initiated efforts to digitize waqf records under the **Waqf Management System of India (WAMSI)** to improve transparency and accountability.
 
• **Role of Central Waqf Council:** The Central Waqf Council provides guidance and oversight to state Waqf Boards and also supports them in capacity building and resolving disputes.
 
• **Revenue Generation:** Effective management of waqf properties can generate significant revenue, which can be utilized for community welfare and development programs.
 
• **Community Welfare:** Waqf properties are instrumental in funding educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and other welfare initiatives for the Muslim community in India.
